content.what_it_is: MATLAB example script (tools/plot_googlemap) that renders FUNWAVE binary eta/mask snapshots over a Google satellite map and writes an AVI movie. Configuration: source='DMI1_Sid', region=5 (L2-3); five lon/lat axis boxes ax1-ax5 (L5-9); unused view/light settings look_height/look_h/look_v/col (L11-14); data roots under /Volumes/2TB_element/DHI_CRD/ (L16-19, commented alternates L22-24); frame numbers fnames=[40:1:160] (L26), color limits cmax=5/cmin=-5 (L28-29). Five-region catalogs: GridX cell array of UTM lower-left corners (L31) and DimsX of grid dimensions (L33); m/n and xllcorner/yllcorner picked by region (L35-39). Grid corner coordinates x1=x0+(m-1)*4, y1=y0+(n-1)*4 assume 4 m spacing (L43-44); converted to WGS84 with utm2ll zone 10 (L46-47); lat/lon vectors linearly spanned (L49-50). Figure sized len=10 in, wid=len*m/n*1.4 (L55-58). VideoWriter 'movie5.avi' at FrameRate 10 (L62-64). Loop over frames (L67-118): builds 5-digit file suffix (L69), time label ftim=(fnames-1)*30/60 min (L70,L73), cds to results dir via eval (L75), freads eta_ and mask_ files as single with DimsX{region} shape and transposes (L76-84), masks dry cells eta(mask<1)=NaN (L86), cds to movie dir (L88), plots corner markers (L93), plot_google_map satellite background with placeholder API key (L94), pcolor(lon,lat,eta) shading flat (L99), axes/labels/colorbar/caxis/title (L101-108), draws white ax2 box outline (L109-111), pauses 0.2 s (L113), grabs frame and writes to video (L115-116). Closes video (L119).
